subject: Castor canadensis
creator: Sean Frey
alt: A beaver at the surface of warm-lit pond water has its head/body low while a large bright splash erupts behind it. Fine droplets arc above the impact and concentric ripples cross the surface. The source explicitly describes a tail slap. Animal partly submerged; no other beaver or predator visible.
detail: The desire to inspect her own splash, two repeats, missed views and gentle final plop are original fiction around the documented slap/dive. They are not a reported behavioral experiment or a claim beavers cannot ever slap without diving. The photographed large splash belongs to an early attempt, not the smaller final one. Source chronology among eight images is not inferred.
